text_en:
China's Shanghai Composite closed on Aug 20 (Thursday) up 9.3 points, or 0.24%, at 3903.72 points.
China's Shenzhen Component closed on Aug 20 (Thursday) up 82.63 points, or 0.59%, at 13972.78 points.
China's CSI 300 closed on Aug 20 (Thursday) up 4.05 points, or 0.09%, at 4592.75 points.
China's ChiNext Index closed on Aug 20 (Thursday) up 22.09 points, or 0.64%, at 3495.59 points.
China's STAR 50 Index closed on Aug 20 (Thursday) down 14.55 points, or 0.87%, at 1652.97 points.
